claims.text: The chat log carries two locating messages from the rider during the pickup attempt. At 12:41:05 she wrote 'hi im at the entrance 3 phv pickup point, which car ah?' - her own position plus a request for the driver's position - and at 12:44:40, squarely inside the waiting window that opened with the 12:41:50 arrival and closed with the 12:47:30 cancellation, she wrote 'boss? i still cannot see u leh', which is the 'statement that they cannot see the vehicle' POL-NS-04(a) names as locating content. Limb (a) of POL-NS-04 is met on the face of the chat log.

The driver never answered. Both of the rider's messages carry read receipts (read_at 12:41:22 and 12:44:52), and no entry anywhere in the chat log is sent by the driver, so no reply was posted within 120 seconds of either message - the 12:44:40 message left 170 seconds to the 12:47:30 cancellation with no answer. trip_record.in_app_calls is an empty array, so no in-app voice call was placed at any point before he terminated the trip. Limb (b) of POL-NS-04 is met.

The rider's device was at the pickup point the whole time. Her track carries 105 fixes, all 105 of them qualifying, with a mean distance of 21.08 m and a maximum distance of 39.93 m from the pickup pin - far inside the 150 m rider_presence_radius_m for a LARGE_VENUE. Limb (c) of POL-NS-04 is therefore satisfied across the entire waiting window, not merely across a majority of it.

All three limbs of POL-NS-04 hold together, so the rider is exonerated and the cancellation fee is refunded in full with no driver compensation payable. POL-NS-04 sits inside the displacing set POL-NS-01 itself defers to - POL-NS-01 charges the fee only where no clause from POL-NS-03 to POL-NS-06 displaces it - so the baseline charge never arises here, and on POL-GEN-03 the outcome for the filing rider is a FULL_REFUND of the contested SGD 4.00.

The trace corroborates the rider's account of not being able to see the car rather than any suggestion that she was absent: the driver's closest approach across his 35 in-geofence fixes was 94.94 m from the pickup pin, while the rider never moved more than 39.93 m from that same pin. A rider standing at the pin and a car holding roughly 95 m away is exactly the situation her 12:44:40 message describes.

The locating message the driver actually read named the meeting point - 'hi im at the entrance 3 phv pickup point' - and the trip record's pickup is 'Jurong Point, PHV Pickup Point, Entrance 3', so the entrance identifier POL-NS-04(a) contemplates was present in the chat and matched the registered pick-up sub-location. The filed claim's later narrative refers to 'Entrance 1'; that is the write-up, not the message on file, and it goes to no limb of POL-NS-04.

The driver has offered no account of the pickup at all - counterparty_statement is null. The only signal from his side is his own termination reason code RIDER_UNREACHABLE, and the chat log contradicts it directly: he read both of the rider's messages and made no reply and no in-app call, so 'unreachable' cannot describe a rider who was messaging, whose messages were being read, and who stood within 40 m of the pin for the whole wait.

The money is simple. fare_breakdown shows a single cancellation_fee line of SGD 4.00 charged at 12:47:48 on 2026-07-26, a SGD 0.50 platform fee, a SGD 4.50 total, and refund_issued_sgd of 0.00, i.e. nothing has yet been returned. SGD 4.00 is also the correct scheduled figure - the greater of the SGD 4.00 LARGE_VENUE zone-class fee and the SGD 4.00 RYDE_X vehicle-tier fee - so the full refund the rider seeks is the whole of the contested SGD 4.00, not a lesser or split sum.

This case can and should be decided now rather than held. No POL-NS-09 trigger is engaged: neither party's disputes_with_counterparty_90d rises above 0, the rider's no_show_disputes_30d is 0, and the POL-NS-07 anti-farming check does not trip - 3 no_show_terminations_30d against 142 completed_trips_30d is a rate of 0.021, under the 0.08 threshold, and 3 is under the absolute count of 4. I cite those two driver fields only for the test POL-GEN-01 assigns them to. Escalation would simply hold the rider's SGD 4.00 while the record already answers the question.

The artifacts carrying the deciding facts show none of the POL-NS-08 defects, so nothing caps this case at PARTIAL_REFUND or forces escalation: arrived_at 12:41:50 is the same timestamp as the first qualifying in-geofence fix, so the clock-skew limb (a) is absent (0 seconds against a 90 second tolerance); the trace has 87 fixes, an empty gaps array and max_gap_sec of 0.0, so limb (b) is absent; the chat log's 3 messages match trip_record.chat_message_count of 3 with an unbroken msg_id sequence, so limb (c) is absent; and the SGD 4.00 cancellation-fee line equals the greater of the SGD 4.00 LARGE_VENUE zone-class fee and the SGD 4.00 RYDE_X vehicle-tier fee, so limb (d) is absent.

EV-ADVIS-00204-01 is a MISSING traffic advisory: it carries no payload and weight 0.0, so there is no advisory of any admissible type (KERB_RESTRICTION, ENFORCEMENT, CLOSURE or ACCIDENT) covering this pickup road or this waiting period. The driver can point to no kerbside restriction, enforcement operation, closure or incident that kept him from covering the last ~95 m to the pin, and POL-NS-06's accumulation limb is unavailable on a missing advisory in any event - its absence is itself the point.

claims.text: POL-NS-01 limbs (a) and (b) are both satisfied on the platform's own telemetry. The trip record carries a driver 'arrived' event at 12:41:50, and the GPS trace places the driver inside the pickup geofence at that moment: his closest approach to the pin is 94.94 m, comfortably inside the 120 m arrival radius POL-NS-02 fixes for a LARGE_VENUE pickup, and the trace returns 35 qualifying in-radius fixes (well over the three consecutive fixes POL-NS-02 requires).

The dwell requirement of POL-NS-01 limb (c) is met with margin. The driver held position inside the geofence for a continuous 340 seconds, running from the first qualifying fix at 12:41:50 to the cancellation fix at 12:47:30 - 40 seconds more than the 300-second minimum for LARGE_VENUE. The derived shortfall basis returns -40 s on the longest qualifying run, so there is no shortfall for POL-NS-06 to refund; the waiting period was served in full.

Limb (d) of POL-NS-01 is satisfied as well. The trip record shows no boarding event and records the trip as CANCELLED_BY_DRIVER with cancellation_reason_code RIDER_UNREACHABLE, one of the three reason codes that limb recognises, entered at 12:47:30 after the required dwell had already elapsed.

POL-NS-05 is not engaged. The driver's in-geofence stationary run begins at exactly the 12:41:50 arrival timestamp, so at the arrival marker he was neither more than 300 m from the pin nor travelling at or above the 15 kph motion threshold; the trace's only non-zero speed is 24.9 kph on the approach, before the geofence was entered. There is no false arrival marker, the waiting clock is not recomputed against the driver, and limb (iii) preserves the fee on the corrected computation in any event.

On the baseline case the driver is owed compensation under POL-NS-07 at 80 percent of the cancellation fee - SGD 3.20 of the SGD 4.00 itemised in the ledger - and the anti-farming check does not trip: driver_profile.no_show_terminations_30d is 3, below the threshold of 4, and 3 divided by driver_profile.completed_trips_30d of 142 is 0.021, far below the 0.08 rate. Both limbs of the check must fail together, and neither is met. Per POL-GEN-01 those are the only two profile fields this test reads, so no other counter on either profile is relied on; per POL-GEN-03 the ruling value would be DRIVER_COMPENSATION with amount_sgd mirroring driver_compensation_sgd.

The rider's answer is POL-NS-04, and the driver states plainly what the chat record shows: the rider's 12:44:40 message ('i still cannot see u leh') is a statement that he cannot see the vehicle sent inside the 12:41:50-12:47:30 waiting window, the log records no driver reply within 120 seconds of it, and trip_record.in_app_calls is empty, so limbs (a) and (b) are made out; the rider track keeps the rider within 39.93 m of the pin, inside the 150 m LARGE_VENUE presence radius, so limb (c) is satisfied too. The driver does not contest that record, and if POL-NS-04 is applied it displaces POL-NS-01 and no compensation is payable. The driver's submission on quantum is narrow and supported: any refund must be confined to the SGD 4.00 cancellation-fee line and must not reach the SGD 0.50 platform fee carried in the same ledger, because POL-NS-06 refunds the cancellation-fee line only and POL-GEN-03 measures the refund by the contested amount.

ruling.explanation:
To both parties: the SGD 4.00 no-show cancellation fee charged on 26 July 2026 does not stand. It is refunded to the rider in full, and no driver compensation is payable.

Driver, your baseline case is made out on the platform's own telemetry, and I accept it. The trip record (EV-TRIP-00204) carries a driver 'arrived' event at 12:41:50 and shows the trip terminated by you at 12:47:30 under reason code RIDER_UNREACHABLE with no boarding. The GPS trace (EV-GPS-00204) places your closest approach to the pickup pin at 94.94 m — inside the 120 m arrival radius for this LARGE_VENUE pickup — with 35 qualifying in-radius fixes, and shows you holding position inside the geofence for a continuous 340 seconds from 12:41:50, 40 seconds more than the 300-second minimum. On those figures POL-NS-01 limbs (a) to (d) all hold, POL-NS-05 is not engaged (your in-geofence run starts at the arrival timestamp, so there is no false marker and no recomputation against you), and your POL-NS-07 claim of SGD 3.20 (80% of SGD 4.00) would be good: the anti-farming check does not trip, since no_show_terminations_30d of 3 is below the count of 4 and 3/142 completed trips is a rate of 0.021 against the 0.08 threshold.

But POL-NS-04 displaces that baseline, and your own submission concedes it. The chat log (EV-CHAT-00204) shows the rider sending coordinating messages at 12:41:05 ('...entrance 3 phv pickup point, which car ah?') and at 12:44:40 ('boss? i still cannot see u leh'), both read by you (12:41:22 and 12:44:52). You posted no reply at any point and trip_record.in_app_calls is empty, so 170 seconds elapsed between the 12:44:40 message and your cancellation with no answer and no call. The rider's track (EV-GPS-00204) keeps her within 39.93 m of the pin across all 105 qualifying fixes, inside the 150 m presence radius for this zone class. All three limbs of POL-NS-04 are therefore made out, the rider is exonerated, and the fee is refunded in full with no driver compensation — which is what POL-NS-04 expressly provides and what you concede on quantum. Your narrow point on the money is accepted: the refund is confined to the cancellation-fee line and does not reach the SGD 0.50 platform fee carried in the same ledger.

The amount is the SGD 4.00 cancellation_fee line in EV-FARE-00204 (charged 12:47:48; refund_issued_sgd 0.00). That line equals the greater of the SGD 4.00 LARGE_VENUE zone-class fee and the SGD 4.00 RYDE_X vehicle-tier fee, so it is the correct scheduled figure and there is no fare defect.

On integrity, no POL-NS-08 defect applies: arrival and first in-geofence fix coincide (0 s against the 90 s clock-skew tolerance); the trace has 87 fixes, no gaps and a maximum gap of 0.0 s; the chat log's 3 messages match the trip record's chat_message_count of 3 with an unbroken msg_id sequence; and the fee line reconciles with the fee schedule. No POL-NS-09 trigger is engaged — confidence is above the 0.70 floor, neither party has any trailing no-show disputes with the other, the rider has no no-show disputes in 30 days, and the POL-NS-07 anti-farming check does not trip. EV-ADVIS-00204-01 is a MISSING traffic advisory (weight 0.0), but nothing in this ruling rests on it: with a single in-geofence interval, POL-NS-06 limb (i) accumulation is unavailable in any event, so its absence changes nothing. For completeness, the rider's filed narrative refers to 'Entrance 1' while the message on file and the registered pickup point both say Entrance 3; that discrepancy decides no limb, since the geofence tests are met on distance and the rider's device sits within 40 m of the pin.

ruling.explanation:
To both parties — this is the decision on trip TRP-00204 (Jurong Point, 26 July 2026).

Nothing about the physical timeline is in dispute, and the platform's own records fix it. The driver accepted at 12:33:20, the trip record shows an 'arrived' event at 12:41:50, and the GPS trace places him inside the 120 m arrival radius for this LARGE_VENUE pickup at that moment (closest approach 94.94 m; 35 qualifying in-geofence fixes). He then held position for a continuous 340 seconds against a 300-second minimum and cancelled at 12:47:30 with reason code RIDER_UNREACHABLE. The arrival marker is not false: when he tapped he was inside the geofence and stationary, not more than 300 m away and not travelling at 15 km/h or more, so POL-NS-05 does not engage. On that footing the four limbs of POL-NS-01 are made out and the SGD 4.00 fee would stand, with SGD 3.20 to the driver under POL-NS-07.

POL-NS-01, however, charges the fee only where no clause from POL-NS-03 to POL-NS-06 displaces it, and POL-NS-04 does. ruling.explanation:
To both parties: the record is consistent and this case can be decided now.

For the driver: on the platform's own telemetry the baseline conditions of POL-NS-01 were met. You reached the pickup geofence at 12:41:50 (closest approach 94.94 m, inside the 120 m arrival radius fixed for this LARGE_VENUE pin), held position for a continuous 340 seconds against the 300-second minimum, and terminated the trip at 12:47:30 with no boarding and the reason code RIDER_UNREACHABLE. On that baseline the SGD 4.00 charge would stand and you would be owed SGD 3.20 (80 percent of SGD 4.00).

But POL-NS-04 displaces that baseline, and it is made out on the chat log and the rider's track, which you do not contest. The rider sent two locating messages inside the attempt — 'hi im at the entrance 3 phv pickup point, which car ah?' at 12:41:05 and 'boss? i still cannot see u leh' at 12:44:40 — and both were delivered and read (read receipts 12:41:22 and 12:44:52). You posted no reply within 120 seconds of either message and placed no in-app call (trip_record.in_app_calls is empty). The rider's device stayed within 39.93 m of the pin at its furthest (mean 21.08 m) across all 105 qualifying fixes, inside the 150 m presence radius for this zone class. All three limbs of POL-NS-04 hold: the rider is exonerated, the SGD 4.00 cancellation fee is refunded in full, and no driver compensation is payable. POL-NS-04 provides no compensation, and by displacing POL-NS-01 it removes the basis for the SGD 3.20 claimed under POL-NS-07.

For the rider: you are refunded the SGD 4.00 cancellation fee charged at 12:47:48 on 2026-07-26. That figure is the greater of the SGD 4.00 LARGE_VENUE zone-class fee and the SGD 4.00 RYDE_X vehicle-tier fee, and it is the whole of the amount you contested. The SGD 0.50 platform fee in the same ledger is not part of the contested amount and is not refunded — the total charged was SGD 4.50, and the refund returns the cancellation-fee line only.

No POL-NS-05 false-arrival finding arises: your in-geofence stationary run begins exactly at the 12:41:50 arrival timestamp, inside the radius and at zero speed, and your claim to the contrary is rejected. Your written narrative refers to 'Entrance 1' while the message on file and the trip record both say 'Entrance 3'; the message governs and nothing turns on the discrepancy.

No escalation: no POL-NS-09 trigger is engaged — both parties show 0 counterparty disputes in 90 days, the rider has 0 no-show disputes in 30 days, and the driver's anti-farming figures (3 terminations against 142 completed trips in 30 days, a rate of 0.021) sit below both the absolute count of 4 and the 0.08 rate. No artifact carrying a deciding fact is impaired under POL-NS-08: arrival skew is 0 seconds against a 90-second tolerance, the trace has 87 fixes with an empty gaps array, the chat's 3 messages match the recorded chat_message_count with an unbroken sequence, and the SGD 4.00 fee line reconciles with the fee schedule. The only impaired artifact is EV-ADVIS-00204-01, the traffic advisory, at weight 0.0 because it is MISSING; it carries nothing this ruling rests on and bears only on POL-NS-06(i), which is unavailable on a missing advisory. No clause produces a referral, so none is listed.

ledger.claim: The chat log carries two locating messages from the rider during the pickup attempt. At 12:41:05 she wrote 'hi im at the entrance 3 phv pickup point, which car ah?' - her own position plus a request for the driver's position - and at 12:44:40, squarely inside the waiting window that opened with the 12:41:50 arrival and closed with the 12:47:30 cancellation, she wrote 'boss? i still cannot see u leh', which is the 'statement that they cannot see the vehicle' POL-NS-04(a) names as locating content. Limb (a) of POL-NS-04 is met on the face of the chat log.

The driver never answered. Both of the rider's messages carry read receipts (read_at 12:41:22 and 12:44:52), and no entry anywhere in the chat log is sent by the driver, so no reply was posted within 120 seconds of either message - the 12:44:40 message left 170 seconds to the 12:47:30 cancellation with no answer. trip_record.in_app_calls is an empty array, so no in-app voice call was placed at any point before he terminated the trip. Limb (b) of POL-NS-04 is met.

The rider's device was at the pickup point the whole time. Her track carries 105 fixes, all 105 of them qualifying, with a mean distance of 21.08 m and a maximum distance of 39.93 m from the pickup pin - far inside the 150 m rider_presence_radius_m for a LARGE_VENUE. Limb (c) of POL-NS-04 is therefore satisfied across the entire waiting window, not merely across a majority of it.

All three limbs of POL-NS-04 hold together, so the rider is exonerated and the cancellation fee is refunded in full with no driver compensation payable. POL-NS-04 sits inside the displacing set POL-NS-01 itself defers to - POL-NS-01 charges the fee only where no clause from POL-NS-03 to POL-NS-06 displaces it - so the baseline charge never arises here, and on POL-GEN-03 the outcome for the filing rider is a FULL_REFUND of the contested SGD 4.00.

The trace corroborates the rider's account of not being able to see the car rather than any suggestion that she was absent: the driver's closest approach across his 35 in-geofence fixes was 94.94 m from the pickup pin, while the rider never moved more than 39.93 m from that same pin. A rider standing at the pin and a car holding roughly 95 m away is exactly the situation her 12:44:40 message describes.

The locating message the driver actually read named the meeting point - 'hi im at the entrance 3 phv pickup point' - and the trip record's pickup is 'Jurong Point, PHV Pickup Point, Entrance 3', so the entrance identifier POL-NS-04(a) contemplates was present in the chat and matched the registered pick-up sub-location. The filed claim's later narrative refers to 'Entrance 1'; that is the write-up, not the message on file, and it goes to no limb of POL-NS-04.

The driver has offered no account of the pickup at all - counterparty_statement is null. The only signal from his side is his own termination reason code RIDER_UNREACHABLE, and the chat log contradicts it directly: he read both of the rider's messages and made no reply and no in-app call, so 'unreachable' cannot describe a rider who was messaging, whose messages were being read, and who stood within 40 m of the pin for the whole wait.

The money is simple. fare_breakdown shows a single cancellation_fee line of SGD 4.00 charged at 12:47:48 on 2026-07-26, a SGD 0.50 platform fee, a SGD 4.50 total, and refund_issued_sgd of 0.00, i.e. nothing has yet been returned. SGD 4.00 is also the correct scheduled figure - the greater of the SGD 4.00 LARGE_VENUE zone-class fee and the SGD 4.00 RYDE_X vehicle-tier fee - so the full refund the rider seeks is the whole of the contested SGD 4.00, not a lesser or split sum.

This case can and should be decided now rather than held. No POL-NS-09 trigger is engaged: neither party's disputes_with_counterparty_90d rises above 0, the rider's no_show_disputes_30d is 0, and the POL-NS-07 anti-farming check does not trip - 3 no_show_terminations_30d against 142 completed_trips_30d is a rate of 0.021, under the 0.08 threshold, and 3 is under the absolute count of 4. I cite those two driver fields only for the test POL-GEN-01 assigns them to. Escalation would simply hold the rider's SGD 4.00 while the record already answers the question.

The artifacts carrying the deciding facts show none of the POL-NS-08 defects, so nothing caps this case at PARTIAL_REFUND or forces escalation: arrived_at 12:41:50 is the same timestamp as the first qualifying in-geofence fix, so the clock-skew limb (a) is absent (0 seconds against a 90 second tolerance); the trace has 87 fixes, an empty gaps array and max_gap_sec of 0.0, so limb (b) is absent; the chat log's 3 messages match trip_record.chat_message_count of 3 with an unbroken msg_id sequence, so limb (c) is absent; and the SGD 4.00 cancellation-fee line equals the greater of the SGD 4.00 LARGE_VENUE zone-class fee and the SGD 4.00 RYDE_X vehicle-tier fee, so limb (d) is absent.

EV-ADVIS-00204-01 is a MISSING traffic advisory: it carries no payload and weight 0.0, so there is no advisory of any admissible type (KERB_RESTRICTION, ENFORCEMENT, CLOSURE or ACCIDENT) covering this pickup road or this waiting period. The driver can point to no kerbside restriction, enforcement operation, closure or incident that kept him from covering the last ~95 m to the pin, and POL-NS-06's accumulation limb is unavailable on a missing advisory in any event - its absence is itself the point.

POL-NS-01 limbs (a) and (b) are both satisfied on the platform's own telemetry. The trip record carries a driver 'arrived' event at 12:41:50, and the GPS trace places the driver inside the pickup geofence at that moment: his closest approach to the pin is 94.94 m, comfortably inside the 120 m arrival radius POL-NS-02 fixes for a LARGE_VENUE pickup, and the trace returns 35 qualifying in-radius fixes (well over the three consecutive fixes POL-NS-02 requires).

The dwell requirement of POL-NS-01 limb (c) is met with margin. The driver held position inside the geofence for a continuous 340 seconds, running from the first qualifying fix at 12:41:50 to the cancellation fix at 12:47:30 - 40 seconds more than the 300-second minimum for LARGE_VENUE. The derived shortfall basis returns -40 s on the longest qualifying run, so there is no shortfall for POL-NS-06 to refund; the waiting period was served in full.

Limb (d) of POL-NS-01 is satisfied as well. The trip record shows no boarding event and records the trip as CANCELLED_BY_DRIVER with cancellation_reason_code RIDER_UNREACHABLE, one of the three reason codes that limb recognises, entered at 12:47:30 after the required dwell had already elapsed.

POL-NS-05 is not engaged. The driver's in-geofence stationary run begins at exactly the 12:41:50 arrival timestamp, so at the arrival marker he was neither more than 300 m from the pin nor travelling at or above the 15 kph motion threshold; the trace's only non-zero speed is 24.9 kph on the approach, before the geofence was entered. There is no false arrival marker, the waiting clock is not recomputed against the driver, and limb (iii) preserves the fee on the corrected computation in any event.

On the baseline case the driver is owed compensation under POL-NS-07 at 80 percent of the cancellation fee - SGD 3.20 of the SGD 4.00 itemised in the ledger - and the anti-farming check does not trip: driver_profile.no_show_terminations_30d is 3, below the threshold of 4, and 3 divided by driver_profile.completed_trips_30d of 142 is 0.021, far below the 0.08 rate. Both limbs of the check must fail together, and neither is met. Per POL-GEN-01 those are the only two profile fields this test reads, so no other counter on either profile is relied on; per POL-GEN-03 the ruling value would be DRIVER_COMPENSATION with amount_sgd mirroring driver_compensation_sgd.

The rider's answer is POL-NS-04, and the driver states plainly what the chat record shows: the rider's 12:44:40 message ('i still cannot see u leh') is a statement that he cannot see the vehicle sent inside the 12:41:50-12:47:30 waiting window, the log records no driver reply within 120 seconds of it, and trip_record.in_app_calls is empty, so limbs (a) and (b) are made out; the rider track keeps the rider within 39.93 m of the pin, inside the 150 m LARGE_VENUE presence radius, so limb (c) is satisfied too. The driver does not contest that record, and if POL-NS-04 is applied it displaces POL-NS-01 and no compensation is payable. The driver's submission on quantum is narrow and supported: any refund must be confined to the SGD 4.00 cancellation-fee line and must not reach the SGD 0.50 platform fee carried in the same ledger, because POL-NS-06 refunds the cancellation-fee line only and POL-GEN-03 measures the refund by the contested amount.
